content: Standard DD data room folder taxonomy is a ~10-category structure: Corporate, Financial, Customers, Suppliers, Employees, IP, Real Estate, Legal, Operations, Strategic (with subfolders e.g. Tax Filings, Contracts, IP Rights). A three-tier diligence access model is common: Tier 1 pre-LOI (teaser-level), Tier 2 post-LOI (broader), Tier 3 confirmatory (full). Clean rooms let buyers compute aggregated metrics (e.g. LTV by cohort) without ever exporting raw customer PII.
